Warrior spellbook

36 trainer spells across 3 schools, and what the class may wear and hold, read from the Forever client, build 1.60.1.70862. Talent calculator →

Warrior armour and weapons

What a Warrior can wear and hold, read from the Forever client's own skill tables: the half of the kit the spellbook never lists. Everything is usable from level 1 apart from plate mail at 40, polearms at 20 and dual wield at 20.

Armour

  • Cloth From the start
  • Leather From the start
  • Mail From the start
  • Plate Mail Level 40

Off hand: Shield, from level 1.

Weapons

  • Daggers
  • Fist Weapons
  • Swords
  • Axes
  • Maces
  • Staves
  • Polearms Level 20
  • Two-Handed Swords

  • Two-Handed Maces
  • Bows
  • Crossbows
  • Guns
  • Thrown

Dual wield

Dual Wield : A Warrior can dual wield from level 20.
